decisions.statement: An envelope names the error type upstream gave the failure.
An envelope has a message as an optional field.
A body with keys the envelope does not name still parses.
A body the JSON parser refuses parses to nothing.
A body with no envelope parses to nothing.
A payload naming a type other than `error` parses to nothing.
A `__proto__` key in the parsed body reaches no prototype.
Nothing here decides the meaning of a failure.
Nothing here reads the status a failure arrived with.

definition: the error shape upstream wraps a failure in
